rasterize_mesh_triangles: rasterize a mesh defined by vertex positions and face indices into a triangle index image
rasterize_wireframe_mode: rasterize a mesh in wireframe mode using edge visibility bit fields in face indices
rasterize_with_depth_image: rasterize a mesh and return both triangle indices and a non-differentiable depth image
rasterize_batched_meshes: rasterize a batch of meshes with shape N x V x 3 vertices and N x F x 3 faces
rasterize_single_mesh: rasterize a single mesh with 2D face indices of shape F x 3 automatically expanded to batch
